fixtures.prompt: Fix calculator.add so it returns the arithmetic sum of its two arguments. Inspect the implementation and tests, run the configured baseline test before editing, change only calculator.py, rerun the tests, and finish completed only when they pass.

fixtures.title: Normalize mixed and repeated whitespace
fixtures.prompt: Fix normalizer.slugify. It must strip leading and trailing whitespace, split on any run of whitespace, lowercase each word, and join words with one hyphen. Inspect code and tests, run the baseline first, edit only normalizer.py, and verify with the configured test.

fixtures.title: Implement a bounded median helper
fixtures.prompt: Implement stats.median. Return the middle value for odd-length inputs and the arithmetic mean of the two middle values for even-length inputs. Raise ValueError for an empty input and do not mutate the caller's list. Run the baseline before editing and the configured test after editing stats.py.

fixtures.title: Implement and export a chunking helper
fixtures.prompt: Add miniapp.chunks.chunked(values, size) and re-export it from miniapp.__init__. The helper must return lists of at most size items, preserve order, and raise ValueError when size is zero or negative. The implementation must be in miniapp/chunks.py and the public export in miniapp/__init__.py. Run the baseline before changing both files and rerun the configured test afterward.
